subcodes.title: Grace spoken at Hearst estate in Pleasanton, CA, 1912-Oct-14
subcodes.first_line: Thou seest us, O my God, gathered around this table, praising Thy bounty, with our gaze set upon Thy Kingdom.
subcodes.first_line_orig: ترانا یا الهی مجتمعین علی هذه المائدة شاکرین لنعمتک ناظرین الی ملکوتک
full_text_parts: He is God! Thou seest us, O my God, gathered around this table, praising Thy bounty, with our gaze set upon Thy Kingdom. O Lord! Send down upon us Thy heavenly food and confer upon us Thy blessing. Thou art verily the Bestower, the Merciful, the Compassionate.
